title: Long-Tenure Treatment of Level Drops on Ship-To Reactivation
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — tenure of the delivery location at reactivation.**

The total of level drops a reactivation carries is adjusted for the ship-to's tenure, measured in whole months from its opened date to the reactivation date (0 months where the ship-to has no opened date): for a ship-to open at least 180 months the total is halved and rounded down to a whole drop; for a ship-to open at least 96 and fewer than 180 months one drop is taken off the total, never below zero. A ship-to open fewer than 96 months has no adjustment under this rule.

Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.

| Whole months open on the reactivation date | Treatment of the total |
|---|---|
| 180 or more | halved, rounded down to a whole drop |
| 96 to 179 | one drop taken off, never below zero |
| fewer than 96, or no opened date | none under this rule |

**Hypothetical totals**

| Total before this rule | Open 200 months | Open 120 months | Open 40 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
| 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
